Definition: A description of one kind of input, such as the Space key being pressed or the left mouse button being clicked.
A list that connects input sets to the behaviors that should run when that input happens.
The input table every game starts with. It holds keys that work everywhere, such as Tab to move the focus.
A short piece of text stored on an item. It tells the game which input table to use when that item has the focus.
The item that keyboard input goes to right now. Only one item has the focus at a time.
The moment a behavior runs: when input begins, while it continues or when it finishes.
A key held down with another key or a click, such as Shift, Ctrl, Alt or Command.
How many times input must happen quickly in a row, such as 2 for a double-click.
